messages:
Alex Monroe: Hey everyone — trying to finish onboarding. When I click the Okta link from the welcome email via MS Edge it jumps to an 'account mismatch' page. I have two Google accounts (one personal) and Edge keeps auto-selecting the wrong one. Also 1Password says no seat found. Any quick unblock so I can access the handbook?

Riley (IT): Hi Alex, welcome! Edge + multiple Google accounts is a known quirky combo. Quick tries: 1) open an InPrivate window, 2) use a different browser like Chrome/Firefox, or 3) sign out of all Google accounts first. If none work I can re-send the invite to an alias (e.g., alex.monroe+rw@) or enable the account chooser on our end. Do you have a security key or phone MFA only?

Alex Monroe: I only have phone MFA. I tried InPrivate and it still forwarded to mismatch. My company email is alex.monroe@redwood.com and I also have alex.monroe.personal@gmail.com. I can try Chrome but would rather not install extra software on my work laptop yet.

Riley (IT): Understood. I'll reprovision the Okta invite to alex.monroe+work@gmail.com — that usually avoids auto-pick. Also I'll create a temporary Drive share (view-only) so you can read the handbook right away.

Onboarding Bot: Ticket #7802 opened -> IT:okta assigned to Riley. ETA ~2 hours.

Marta (People Ops): Alex, I approved a 1Password seat request (ticket #7804). Riley, can you ensure they get added to the "new-hires" group so seats sync? Evan, please confirm manager approval.

Evan (Hiring Manager): Approved. Welcome Alex! I've asked ops to add you to the "eng-onboarding" folder. 

Riley (IT): Done: reprovisioned invite to alex.monroe+work@gmail.com and added a provisional Drive share (Viewer). 1Password seat is queued; group sync usually finishes within 10-15 minutes. We'll ship a security key option (YubiKey) to the address on file; use phone MFA until it arrives.

Alex Monroe: I can access the Drive folder now and I got the 1Password invite. Thanks! Quick Q: where's the doc for adding passkeys vs YubiKey? I'm on Windows and want to set Windows Hello or a hardware key later.

Riley (IT): Check handbook -> IT/onboarding -> "SSO & MFA". Short steps for Windows Hello or security key:
```
- Okta dashboard > Settings > Security Methods
- Choose 'Add security key' or 'Add passkey'
- For Windows Hello: follow the system prompt to register face/Pin
- For YubiKey: insert > touch when prompted
```
If you want, I can remote into your laptop to walk through enrollment once the key arrives.

Alex Monroe: Perfect, appreciate it. All unblocked for now.
